verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that walks the agent through authoring a skill with a TDD loop: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the SKILL.md, watch them pass, then close loopholes (docs-15, docs-62, docs-50). It also documents where skills live (`skills/` as source of truth, `~/.agents/skills/` as a cross-runtime alias) and provides an evals harness that checks skill compliance on real LLM sessions (docs-13, docs-31, docs-14). Missing for 10: explicit packaging/distribution steps (plugin or marketplace publishing of a new skill), a concrete SKILL.md template or schema in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents authoring skills end to end.
